description: Defines composable functions for calculating scrollbar states based on various LazyList, LazyGrid, and LazyStaggeredGrid states in Jetpack Compose, including internal utility functions.

methods.name: LazyListState.scrollbarState
methods.description: Calculates scrollbar state based on LazyListState changes, considering visible items and their positions.

methods.name: LazyGridState.scrollbarState
methods.description: Calculates scrollbar state based on LazyGridState changes, considering orientation and visible items.

methods.name: LazyStaggeredGridState.scrollbarState
methods.description: Calculates scrollbar state for LazyStaggeredGridState, considering lane and orientation.

methods.name: floatSumOf
methods.description: Utility extension function to sum a list of items by a float selector.
